visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white knit sweater with a prominent grey and white faux-fur collar, is seen in a medium close-up shot holding a large grey and white tabby cat. She looks directly into the camera with a subtle, calm smile while the cat rests in her arms. The background is a white room with a shelf and a wall tapestry featuring French text. (2) The woman leans her head down and nuzzles the top of the cat's head, closing her eyes to show affection. Her hands are clasped around the cat's body, which is looking away toward the side. The lighting is soft and warm, illuminating her face and the textures of the fur collar. (3) She lifts her head back up and smiles broadly at the camera, her eyes crinkling slightly. The cat shifts its position but remains cradled against her chest. She maintains eye contact with the lens while slightly swaying her body. (4) The woman looks down at the cat again, her mouth moving as if speaking softly. She then uses her right hand to adjust the fur collar on her shoulder while the cat begins to move downward, eventually leaving her arms. (5) After the cat has moved out of the frame, she looks back at the camera, performs one last adjustment of her white sweater, and smiles brightly to conclude the sequence. The camera remains static throughout.
